fonts.$comment: Faces from the site (AGD app/layout.tsx, next/font/local; public/fonts). use web: the files the site serves (ABC Diatype variable, wght 400-500, cut to Latin; Agencidev Sans Regular, Latin-1). use render: a static instance of Diatype at 400 (the site sets one weight: labels, buttons and copy all at 400) cut with fontTools for the image and video renderers. Agencidev Sans is the studio's own face. ABC Diatype is Dinamo's: the site's file is their trial build (see licenses/README.md).

type.$comment: Labels, nav links and buttons are 12px capitals, untracked, at 400 (nav-bar.tsx, page-tokens.ts).

logo.source: The site's brand kit (www.agencidev.com/branding, components/branding/brand-kit.tsx) and its lockup (public/agd-lockup.svg)
logo.clearSpaceText: Keep clear space around the mark and never recolor or distort it (brand kit). The kit gives no measure; the library keeps half the square's height free on all four sides, a minimum.
rules: The mark is the square: white on dark, black on light.
The liquid-glass mark where it must read over imagery.
